newsitem.title: USA: Olympic Cascade sued for $4.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Olympic Cascade sued for $4.5 mln.

text.p: Olympic Cascade Financial Corp and its unit National Securities Corp have been sued for $4.5 million over allegations of fraud, negligent misrepresentation, breach of contract and other claims, the plaintiffs' attorneys said on Tuesday.
The suit, filed in U.S. District Court for the Central District of California, claims the companies "engaged in a conspiracy and failed to perform" on a pledge to purchase certain securities.
It seeks $4.5 million plus punitive damages.
Olympic Cascade officials were not available for comment.
Plaintiffs Maxal Trust of New York, Shropshire Capital Corp of Nevada and other individuals are being represented by the law firm Prevenost, Normandin, Bergh & Dawe based in Santa Ana, California.
The suit was filed on April 24.
